en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a broad, tree‑lined street with a cobblestone surface and several pedestrians and horse‑drawn vehicles. Dominating the background is a tall round tower with a richly decorated Gothic spire and pinnacles, belonging to the Schlosskirche (Castle Church). Printed text at the top right identifies the location as Wittenberg and the street as Dessauer Straße with the Castle Church.
